name: Database
description: SurrealDB access mediated by the kernel. Plugins never open a DB connection or supply free-form SurQL by default; the kernel scopes every call to the active org and the plugin's allowed models.

capabilities.name: Query
capabilities.description: Structured reads: get / find by model name. The kernel builds parameterized SurQL — plugins do not send raw queries.

capabilities.name: Bulk Mutation
capabilities.description: Capability for running multiple create, update or delete at once.

capabilities.name: Transaction
capabilities.description: Run a batch of structured db::* ops inscodee a single transaction.
